source.title: 152 One More Night (unity) Free Pixel Art Interactive Fiction Game Gameboy Style 4 color summer holiday
source.description: This is a short interactive fiction story, and no puzzly adventure, about 3 girls spending the end of their summer holidays camping in the woods. There are no puzzles but a fun chiptune soundtrack and a lot of beautiful 4 color gameboy style pixelart graphics to gaze at. No wonder, the whole game was made for a gameboy jam. It takes around 5 minutes and is fun to get through... _________________________________________________ Join the Future Vintage Gaming Discord server | https://discord.gg/m5eaZh8 SUPPORT play the games, have fun, leave a tip! | https://triptilt.itch.io/ buy me a koffee | https://ko-fi.com/futurevintagegaming __________________________________________________ Synopsis: onemore night is a Visual Novel created for the #gbjam 4. A magical summer-themed game about friendship, love and getting drunk in nature. Three friends embark on a two-day camping trip before their last year of school begins. A trip they never want to end. They want to stay one more night.
